class: Running the app live against the same database the test suites use leaves committed rows (a real catalogue, a saved draft, a broker session) that tests written for an empty database then trip over, so local database tests fail for an environmental reason and verifiers must discount failures by hand.
mechanism: 2026-10-15: the live W-065 proof and the 4a gate checks loaded 7,397 real catalogue rows and saved draft 948 into ofo_test; local runs of the catalogue and strategy tests then failed on 'catalogue table must be empty (tests roll back)' and the ADR-058 delist refusal (62-84 failures per run), while CI on its own empty database passed.

first_seen.where: ofo_test on the Windows VPS PostgreSQL
first_seen.evidence: #204 builder: 22 of 101 tests failed with 'catalogue table must be empty'; #208 verifier: 62 'Catalogue update refused ... (ADR-058)' + 1 'strategy store holds rows'.

fix: Owner decision ADR-078 (2026-10-15): live runs use a separate database ofo_dev on the same host (created 2026-10-15, migrated to head, CONNECT only for ofo_app); ofo_test was returned to empty for the live-run tables the same day (catalogue 7,397 + broker rows 7,397 + 1 strategy truncated; audit, ledger and sessions untouched), after which tests_app/test_catalogue_load_command.py and test_broker_instruments.py passed locally (20 passed).

detection.note: Mitigated by ADR-078; still no check stops a live run from pointing at ofo_test (candidate structural guard: the app refuses LIVE_MARKET=1 when its database is the test database).
